notes: Board of Park Commissioners minutes, 1927. Curated: bequests, dedications and monuments.

coverage.remaining: Not placed: the moving of the club houses at the foot of Van Ness Avenue for Aquatic Park (Pearson & Johnson, $7,920; the clubs are not named), the McKinnon Monument dedication (August 21, 1927), the Fairfax H. Wheelan memorial fountain proposed for the Children's Playground, memorial trees for John McLaren and Willis Polk, a proposed Adolph Sutro statue on Sutro Heights, Kezar Stadium football field repairs (Masten & Hurd).
coverage.note: Dated by the date heading over each meeting; 'May 2, 1927' heading carries a stray bullet. Curated list PB1927.py.

findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners heard the will of Helene Strybing read: after life interests to members of her family, the residue of her estate went to the board to lay out an arboretum and botanical garden in Golden Gate Park, preferably near the California Academy of Sciences, holding especially trees, shrubs and plants native to or characteristic of California, with special attention to California wildflowers and medicinal plants.
